data.name: Sohansh
data.gender_notes: Sohansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sohansh is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Soha, meaning 'lord', and Hans, meaning 'universe'. This name signifies the one who is the master of the entire cosmos. The name Sohansh carries the meaning “Lord of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sohansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sohansh is a powerful and spiritual name, evoking a sense of connection to the divine. It is believed to bring prosperity, success, and protection.
data.etymology: Sohansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sohansh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
